neighbors: Not Quite Hollywood: The Wild, Untold Story of Ozploitation
edges: Not Quite Hollywood premiered at the Melbourne International Film Festival.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Austin Ruthyn dies shortly after asking Maud about the ordeal.
Maud Ruthyn learns about her uncle Silas Ruthyn, whom she has never met.
Maud witnesses Dudley murder Madame de la Rougierre by mistake.
Maud Ruthyn's father hires Madame de la Rougierre as a companion for her.
Quentin Tarantino agreed to help get the project Not Quite Hollywood off the ground.
Dudley is thought to be hiding in Australia.
Quentin Tarantino dedicated his film Kill Bill to the exploitation genre.
Luke Goodsell gave Not Quite Hollywood a positive review.
Not Quite Hollywood was nominated for Best Documentary at the 2008 Australian Film Institute Awards.
David Stratton gave Not Quite Hollywood a positive review.
Maud is happily married to Lord Ilbury.
Maud Ruthyn learns about her uncle from her cousin Lady Monica Knollys.
Not Quite Hollywood had its overseas premiere at the Toronto Film Festival.
Margaret Pomeranz gave Not Quite Hollywood a positive review.
Mark Hartley wrote and directed the film Not Quite Hollywood.
